༄༅/ /bdud rtsi sprin phung zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /shog 'dra'i skor/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bdud rtsi sprin phung zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

shog 'dra'i skor/ bdud rtsi sprin phung zhes bya ba/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhyen rab mkha' la thugs rje'i sprin 'khrigs te/ /bdud rtsi'i char gyis phyogs bcu'i 'gro kun gyi/ /nyon mongs nad rnams ma lus zhi mdzad pa/ /sman pa sngon med de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i phrin las gcig bsdus pa/ /bde gshegs rang byung padma rgyal po yis/ /'dab stong bdag blo'i yid kyi tshal lhung bas/ /skal ldan bung ba rab tu tshim par bya/ /de yang rdo rje'i lus 'di la/ /bde chen longs spyod chos dang sprul/ / bde skyong 'khor lo lnga yod de/ /mkha' 'gro sde lnga rigs lnga'i gnas/ /ye nas 'od gsal dri ma med/ /rtsa khams yi ge'i tshul du gnas/ /de ni 'byung ba'i byair zug gis/ /'khrugs shing nad rnams 'byung ba na/ /rlung dmigs yi ge'i sbyor ba yis/ /nad rnams 'don par bya ba ni/ /rnal 'byor pa yis 'dir shes bya/ /dang po bde chen 'khor lo ni/ /rtsa 'dab sum brgya drug cu ste/ /dbus na ha gnas shar du a/ /lho ri nub ni byang du sa/ /de dag rdo rje mkha' 'gro dkar/ /yab yum rdo rje thod khrag bsnams/ /sbyor mtshams dwangs ma babs pa yis/ /mgo dang snying ga'i mtshams su babs/ /tsha grang nad rnams zhi bar bsam/ /rlung ni phyir 'phangs nang du gzung*/ /tsha ba'i nad ni dwangs la bsil/ /grang ba bad kan 'dus pa la/ /rab tu tsha bas gang bar bsgom/ /rlung yang bad rlung grang ba la/ /thog mar phyir sbur nang du gzung*/ / tshad nad la ni gzung mi bya/ /des ni bde chen 'khor lo yi/ /nang gi nad rnams zhi bar byed/ /phyi yi nad ni 'di ltar 'don/ /dmigs pa sngar dang 'dra ba la/ /yi ge bzlas shing 'phangs pa ni/ /ting nge 'dzin gyis gtar bsreg bya/ /gang du na ba khol bur 'don/ /yi ge'i gnas ni 'di lta ste/ / 'phar ba'i ni rtsa nyi shu gnyis/ /'di dag la sogs phyir ru 'phro/ /spyi bo'i gtsug ni drang po na/

/yi ge a ni gnas pa ste/ /sman skad snyan gyi re thag yin/ /'di gtar rims dang snying nad sel/ /'di nas g.yas ni tshon gang na/ /yi ge ga ni gnas pa ste/ /'di ming bho dhe g.yas pa zhes/ /'di gtar gzhog g.yas na la phan/ /de g.yon tshon gang gi yin te/ /de ming bho dhe g.yon pa zhes/ /'di gtar bzhogs yon na la phan/ /de nas sor bzhi mtshogs ma'i steng*/ /ki yig gnas te 'di ming ni/ /ral dmigs chen po zhes bya ste/ /'di dag mgo 'khor 'thibs la phan/ /de g.yas tshon gang btsal ba na/ /ku gnas dung rtsa 'khor ma ste/ /'di gtar ldan g.yas nad la phan/ /de g.yon tshon gang kṣu yin te/ /dung rtsa 'bring bu zhes bya ba/ /'di gtar ldan g.yon nad la phan/ /de nas tshon gang mdun ngos la/ / kṣ+ye gnas ral dmigs chung ngu zhes/ /'di gtar mig gi nad la phan/ /de nas g.yas kyi tshon gang na/ /gnas mkhris rtsa ser po yin/ /'di gtar dang ka 'gribs na phan/ /de yi g.yon nas tshon gang nas/ /ke gnas mkhris pa'i dung bu zhes/ /'di gter kha kha'i nad la phan/ /de nas dpral ba'i dbus na ke/ 'di ming mkhris rtsa ser dung yin/ /'di gtar chang gi nad la phan/ /de g.yas mig gi phug na gyen/ /kaur gnas mig rtsa 'greng bu zhes/ 'di gtar ling thog la sogs phan/ /g.yon pa phug na ko yin te/ /'di ming mig rtsa 'phar ma zhes/ /'di gtar tshad pa'i nad la phan/ /de nas gyen du tshon gang g.yas/ /ka gnas mig rtsa 'phred nyal zhes/ /g.yon gyis 'phrad na kaṃ gnas te/ /'di gnyis mi gtar tsan dan byugs/ /mig gi nad rnams kun la phan/ /de nas phar bcal rtse gtad g.yas/ /tha gnas klad pa 'khyoms la phan/ /rtse gtad g.yon na de bzhin thā/ /'di gtar mig ni lug la phan/ /mig phug g.yas na yi ge thī/ /mig rtsa lhum bu zhes bya ste/ /'di gtar mig rtsa'i nad la phan/ /g.yon gyi phug na thī gnas te/ /mig rtsa gang po zhes bya 'o/ /'di gtar mig ni rno bar byed/

/lce steng g.yas phyogs yas rkan gyi/ /dkar ba'i rtsa gnyis dag la ni/ /thu dang thu gnyis 'khrel ma'i tshul/ /'di ming lce rtsa nag po zhes/ /'di gtar lce phug bros la phan/ /rna ba g.yas nas bhye gnas te/ /g.yon na rtsa gnas mdzum mos mnan/ /'od ni mngon du snang bar gyur/ /mkhur tshos g.yas g.yon ba dang bā/ /'gram zhabs g.yas g.yon bi dang bī/ /rna ba'i tshur 'gram g.yas g.yon na/ /de bzhin bu dang ru gnyis gnas/ /de bzhin phar 'gram g.yas g.yon na/ /bhye bhye gnyis ni gnas pa yin/ /rna ba g.yas pa'i steng 'og na/ /ba bāe g.yon pa'i steng 'og na/ /bo bāo 'gram zur g.yas g.yon na/ /baṃ bāṃ lko gzur g.yas g.yon na/ /ma mā lto mgo g.yas g.yon na/ /mi mī lto stong dag na ni/ /mu mū gnyis po de bzhin no/ kha yi mtha' ni g.yas g.yon na/ /mehya maihya gnyis gnyis gnas pa'o/ /lce yi steng 'og mi lāṃ'o/ /sna bug g.yas g.yon me māe gnyis/ /ya rkan ma rkan dkyil gnyis na/ /maṃ māṃ lta zur g.yas g.yon na/ /tsa tsā ltag khung steng 'og na/ /tsi tsī mjing zur g.yas g.yon na/ /tsu tsū gnyis po de bzhin no/ /mgo bo'i 'bur ni g.yas g.yon na/ / tsehya tsaihya dpral dbyings g.yas g.yon na/ /tse tsāe smin ma g.yas g.yon na/ / tso tsāo ltag pa'i bdud sgo na/ /yi ge tse ni gnas pa yin/ /rtse'u chung g.yas kyi mgo gnyis kyi/ /phar 'gram tshur 'gram gnyis po na/ /nya nyā de bzhin g.yon gnyis na/ /nyi nyī gnyis ni gnas pa'o/ /'gram zur rus mgo g.yas g.yon na/ /nyu nyū gnyis po de bzhin no/ /mig gi lkog ni g.yas g.yon na/ /nyehya nyehya gnyis po yod pa'o/ /mtshogs ma'i khur ni g.yas g.yon na/ /na nā ya mchu'i dkyil gnyis na/ /ni nī ma mchu'i gnyis po na/ nu nū mkhur tshos g.yon g.yon mgo'i/ /rus pa 'phyar ba gnyis na ni/ /behya behya lce zur g.yas g.yon na/ /ne nāe sna bug g.yas g.yon na/ /no nāo lce rtse sna rtse na/

/naṃ nāṃ lkog tse lto stong mgor/ /bhye bhye sna yi rtse gnyis na/ /bhe bhāe gnyis po gnas pa yin/ /rlung sbyor dmigs pa gsal ba yis/ /yi ge bzlas shing phyir la 'don/ /bu ga gzer 'don mda' 'phangs 'dra/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi gtar sreg yin/ /gzhan la dngos su gtar bas phan/ /bde chen 'khor lo'i gnad yig go /gnyis pa longs spyod 'khor lo ni/ /rtsa 'dab bcu drug bdag nyid de/ /dbus na ri dang shar na ha/ /lhor a nub ni byang du sa/ / rin chen mkha' 'gro yab yum lnga/ /rin chen gri gug thod khrag ser/ /sbyor mtshams dwangs ma babs pa yis/ /mgrin dbus nas bzung lus kun gang*/ /tsha grang nad ku na zhi bar bsam/ /rlung 'phangs tsha grang shes par bya/ /nang gi nad kun zhi bar byed/ /phyi rol yi ge sbyor bas 'don/ /mgrin g.yas gyen rgyug e gnas te/ /'di ming rtse'u chung g.yas pa zhes/ /'di gtar mjing pa rtengs la phan/ /g.yon na o gnas rtse'u chung g.yon/ /'di gtar staud ni bsdams pa phan/ /mgo chag khong nad kun la phan/ /dpung pa g.yas na e gnas te/ glo rtsa yon po zhes bya 'o/ /'di gtar glo ni tsha la phan/ /de bzhin g.yon na a gnas te/ /spyi rtsa then po zhes bya ba/ /'di gtar nad rnams kun la phan/ /dpung pa'i nyid kyi g.yas na a/ dug rtsa yon po zhes bya ba/ /'di gtar dug nad kun la phan/ /g.yon a sbal rtsa nag po zhes/ /'di ltar smyo 'bog brgyal la phan/ /dpung zur g.yas g.yon i i te/ sbal rtsa nag po zhes bya ba/ /'di gtar ske nad kun la phan/ / g.yon rig ser rtsa thung po ste/ /'di gtar rtsa yi nad rnam sel/ /o āo sog pa'i me long dkyil/ /'di ming glo rtsa chen po ste/ /'di bsregs mgo bo 'khyoms la phan/ /dpung pa lung mjug dkyil na o/ /gshen thag g.yas pa zhes bya'o/ /'di bsregs dpung pa byung ba sel/ /g.yon par -ii gnas 'di bsregs pas/ /pho ba khengs pa'i nad la phan/

/mgrin 'og khung na ri gnas te/ /ltag pa'i dkyil nas e gnas te/ /li ni rtse mchan g.yas g.yon lī/ / de bzhin mdun gyi e yin no/ /'di kun gtems shing dkrugs pa min/ /yi ge 'di dag gnasapa yi/ /phyogs nas dbugs bcas bzlas pas 'grub/ /dmigs pa'i me yis bsreg pa ste/ /gzhan la me btsas phan pa yin/ /longs spyod 'khor lo'i gnad yin no/ /gsum pa chos kyi 'khor lo ni/ /rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis dbus/ /a gnas shar ha lho phyogs ri/ / nub ni byang du sa gnas pa'i/ /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro yab yum mthing*/ / 'khor lo gri gug thod khrag 'dzin/ /sbyor mtshams bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas/ /lus khengs nad gdon zhi bar bsam/ /rlung gnad la sogs gong bzhin no/ /nang gi nad kun sel bar byed/ /phyi rol yi ge'i sbyor ba ste/ / snying las gyes pa'i rtsa chen ni/ /phyi rol rnam pa 'di ltar snang*/ /lag pa'i gre mang g.yas pa'i gshong*/ /yi ge ka yi mjug mo gnas/ /sman skad 'bab bsam gru mgo yin/ /'di gtar rigs kyi nad kun sel/ /g.yon pa'i gshong na kha yod de/ /'di ming bha la ti ti zhes/ /'di gtar mkhris pa'i nad la phan/ /bad kan nad kun sel bar byed/ /de yi phyi rol g.yas na ga /'di gtar mchin pa'i nad la phan/ /de ming ru thung g.yas pa 'o/ / g.yon na gha gnas ru thung g.yon/ /'di gtar pho ba'i nad la phan/ /lag ngar nang rol dbus na na/ /'di ming mkhris pa'i rgyal mo yin/ /'di gtar mkhris pa'i nad la phan/ /de yi g.yas zur rtsa gnas te/ /mchin rtsa za ma zhes bya ste/ /'di gtar mchin pa'i nad kun sel/ /de yi ro thung nang rol tsha/ /rtsa bran kha kha zhes bya ba/ /'d-i gtar bad kan nad la phan/ /lag ngar mkhrig ma dpral mtshams zur/ /dzā gnas gong rtsa g.yas pa zhes/ /'di gtar glo ba'i nad la phan/ /g.yon na dza gnas gong rtsa g.yon/ /'di gtar lud pa sel la phan/ /mkhrig ma'i rgyab dkyil drang por nya/ /'di ming rgyab rtsa grub mgo zhes/

/'di ltar ro stod nad la phan/ /lag pa'i mtheb mdzub gnyis kyi bar/ /tshon gang bcal ba'i shong bu na/ /ṭa gnas snying rtsa dkar mo zhes/ /'di gtar mkhal mkhris snying nad sel/ /rgyab kyi drang por tha gnas te/ /rgyab rtsa chen mo zhes bya ba/ /'di gtar ro rgyab nad la phan/ /mtheb chung ngos kyi phyi zur ṭa/ /mchin rtsa khron bu zhes bya ba/ /'di gtar lag pa'i nad la phan/ /mthe bong rgyab kyi drang por dha/ /mkhris rtsa ghandhe zhes bya ba/ / 'di gtar mgo bo'i nad la phan/ /mdzub mo'i rgyab na yi ge ṇa/ /pho ba'i yal ga zhes bya ste/ /'di gtar dug gi nad la phan/ /gung mo'i rgyab na ta gnas te/ /mtsher pa'i yal ga zhes bya'o/ /'di gtar srin gyi nad la phan/ /srin lag rgyab na de bzhin tsa/ /mkhal rtsa yon po zhes bya ba/ /'di gtar mkhal ma'i nad la phan/ /mthe'u chung rgyab na da gnas so/ /pho rtsa yon po zhes bya ba/ /'di gtar pho ba'i nad la phan/ /lag mthil dkyil na dha dha gnas/ /mchin pa'i rtsa nag ces bya 'o/ /'di gtar pho mchin 'khor la phan/ /mdzub mo'i ngos na 'khor ba ni/ /na gnas snying rtsa 'khor ma ste/ /'di gtar snying mi dga' ba dang*/ /snying rlung ldang dub nyid la phan/ /rnal 'byor pa yis bzlas shing 'don/ /nu ma'i steng na pa gnas te/ /de yi g.yon na ba gnas so/ mchan khung g.yas na ba gnas te/ /de bzhin g.yon na bha gnas te/ ma ni brang gi lhan sna la/ /pho ba'i steng na la gnas so/ /ya ni rgyab kyi tshigs pa la/ /'di kun phyogs ni gang nar bsreg /rnal 'byor pa yis gtems pas 'grub/ /gtems dang dkrugs dang skyil ba ni/ /phyi rtsa rnams la rab tu gces/ /chos kyi 'khor lo'i gnad yin no/ /bzhi pa sprul pa'i 'khor lo ni/ /rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi'i dbus/ /ni dang shar ha lho phyogs ri/ /nub a byang du sa gnas te/ /padma yab yum dmar mdzes 'dzum/ /padma gri gug thod khrag bsnams/ /sbyor mtshams bdud rtsi'i lus khengs te/

/nad gdon sdig sgrib ma lus dag /rlung gnad la sogs gong dang 'dra/ /phyi rol yi ge'i sbyor ba ni/ /pa pā mkhal khung g.yas dang g.yon/ /sha sha spu nag mtshams na gnas/ /ra ra mkhal ma g.yas g.yon na/ /g.yas su gcud cing g.yon du bor/ /nga pa lte ba'i mdun rgyab na/ /mtheb mdzub gtems pas rlung ni 'gags/ /raṃ ha lte khung 'og dang steng/ /ṭya ṭya rgyu 'og g.yas dang g.yon/ /dza dzā gnyis kyang de bzhin no/ /ṭa ṭā mkhal khung g.yas dang g.yon/ /'di kun gtems pa ma yin te/ /rab tu bzlas shing sbur ba yis/ /'byung ba rnams ni cha snyoms byed/ /sked pa man chad gang na yang*/ / yi ge bzlas shing spros pa yis/ /'byung ba'i nad rnams rang sar 'dzad/ / g.yas g.yon yi ge rang gi gnad/ /tsha grang kha dog dkar dmar ro/ /yi ge kun la nges shes bya/ /lte ba sprul pa'i gnad yin no/ /lnga pa bde skyong 'khor lo ni/ /rtsa 'dab nyi shu rtsa brgyad dbus/ /sa dang shar ha lho phyogs ri/ /nub ni byang du a gnas te/ /las kyi mkha' 'gro yab yum ljang*/ /rgya gram gri gug thod khrag 'dzin/ /sbyor mtshams byang sems babs pa yis/ /lus khengs nad gdon sdig sgrib dag /rlung gnad la sogs gong bzhin no/ /phyi rol yi ge'i sbyor ba ni/ /hū ni sbu gu thung la gnas/ /bsregs pas rengs ba'i nad la phan/ /rnal 'byor pa yis dbugs bcas te/ /phyi nas nang du drang bar bya/ /u i bshang gci gnyis po sgo/ /kṣa ni rkub kyi lung na 'o/ / mdzub mos mnan te rnal 'byor pas/ /dbugs ni gyen la dal gyis drangs/ /nang du yi ge mang por spel/ /lte ba yi ges khengs pa na/ /gtems shing yi ge yid kyis bzlas/ /de ltar goms pas lo gnyis nas/ /zas gos gnyis kyi 'du shes 'gags/ /ra hū brla nang g.yas g.yon na/ /'phar rtsa 'di gnyis mdzub mos btsir/ /sems ni 'bros par 'gyur ba min/ /ṭa la rdo rje'i steng 'og na/ /'di gnyis gtems pas thig le 'gags/

/sha ni rdo rje'i rtse mo na/ /mnyes pas 'dod chags sbyong bar byed/ /lus ni gcong gis zin pa na/ /'di kun bzlas shing gtems pa yis/ /'dus pa'i nad de drungs nas 'byin/ /ti ṭi dpyi mgo g.yas dang g.yon/ /la lā brla khung g.yas dang g.yon/ /mi yi pus mo g.yas dang g.yon/ /'di bsregs sbrid dang 'khums pa 'tsho/ /nya i pus steng g.yas g.yon na/ /'di bsregs mkhal ma'i nad la phan/ /de yang pus mo'i mar mtshan na/ /sor bzhir ngar gdong g.yas pa na/ /yi ge su yi mgo yod de/ /sman skar mcher rtsa nag po zhes/ /'di gtar 'byung ba snyoms pa'i grogs/ /skad 'gags rtsib mar zug la phan/ /de g.yon so so'i mgo gnas te/ /mcher pa'i gsang chung zhes bya'o/ /'di gtar sgal tshigs 'khrid la phan/ /de nas sor bzhi'i gdong g.yas na/ /yi ge ṣa yi mgo gnas te/ /sman skad mkhal ma'i rtsa nag ces/ / 'di gtar lus ni 'khums padang*/ /rkang pa g.yas pa bshal la phan/ / 'byung ba rab tu mnyam par byed/ /g.yon na shai yi mjug yod do/ /chu ser rtsa nag ces bya 'o/ /'di gtar chu ser rgyas pa dang*/ /mdze yi nad la rab tu phan/ /byin pa'i dkyil tshad g.yas pa na/ /yi ge'i kṣa yi mjug yod de/ / sman skad byin mjug ring po zhes/ /'di gtar mkhal ma 'grams la phan/ / g.yon na sha gnas byin mjug thung*/ /'di gtar sgur ba'i nad la phan/ / bol gong g.yas na ṣa yi mjug

/'di gtar glang thabs nad la phan/ /de bzhin g.yon na kṣa gnas te/ /glang bu gya gyu zhes bya 'o/ /'di gtar long nad byung na phan/ /long mo'i phyi mtshan g.yas pa na/ /yi ge kha yi mjug yod de/ /sman skad byin mjug yon po yin/ /'di gtar mkhal ma'i nad la phan/ /de bzhin g.yon na khaṃ gnas te/ /mkhal rtsa 'khyud ma zhes bya ba/ / 'di gtar sked pa 'khyog la phan/ /zha grum nad rnams kun la phan/ /'di kun lnga lnga dbugs dang bcas/ /na sar bton pas phan pa yin/ /yi ge bzlas shing rlung gnad bstun/ /dmigs pa'i nad rnams sreg sbyong gtor/ / mkha' la rgyangs kyis song bar bsgom/ /des ni nad rnams kun la phan/ / bde skyong 'khor lo'i gnad yig go /de ltar phyi nang rtsa nang gi /yi ge 'di kun bzlas pa ni/ /sbrel dang rkyang pa mgo zhabs can/ /'di kun rnal 'byor pas shes bya/ /'khor lo re la dbang ba yi/ /rtsa yi rnam pa na ba'i tshe/ / thams cad sbrel te bzlas par bya/ /de yi g.yas dang g.yon dang dbus/ / tshad ni ji ltar yod pa kun/ /ji skad smros bzhin shes par bya/ /de bzhin 'khor lo'i 'og nas ni/ /steng du mched pa'i nad byung na/ /gong gi yi ges brgyan par bya/ /de bzhin 'og tu mched pa na/ /'og gi yi ges gong mar brgyan/ /'khor lo lnga char 'khrugs pa na/ /thog ma gang nas nad langs pa'i/ /yi ge'i tshig gis sbyar nas ni/ /rlung dmigs gtems gcud bzlas par bya/ /de bzhin thad ka'i nad byung nas/ /bzlas pa dbugs dang bstun nas ni/ /grangs ni nyi shu rtsa re la/ /gang na'i yi ge bzlas pa'i tshe/ /yi ges 'khor lo khengs pa na/ /gcig la gcig thim lus gnad gzir/ /nad ni phyir sangs song bar bsam/ /de ltar yi ge bzlas pa'i tshe/ /ngag ni lcong lcong grul bum skad/ /'don zhing yan lag bskor bar bya/ /de rjes dbugs ni phyir phyung la/ /grang ba la ni dmar po yis/ /nang du bstim zhing snying la bsdu/ /tsha na dkar bas phyi la 'don/

/'di ltar lan grangs nyi shu gcig / bar du lus gnad gzir byas shing*/ /rlung dmigs 'jom pas nad kun grol/ /gdon rnams kun gy-is glags mi rnyed/ /phyi nang yi ge rtsa rlung gnad/ /thams cad 'dir rdzogs khyad par 'phags/ /phyi nang nad rnams gang la yang*/ /'khor lo lnga yi yi ge rnams/ /rtsa yi grangs dang mnyam pa yi/ /mkha' 'gro yab yum mang po dang*/ /ba spu'i grangs dang mnyam pa yi/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo grangs med kyis/ /lus kyi phyi nang bar gsum khyab/ /snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang sems des/ /lus gang nad rnams sangs par bsam/ khyad par na sar bdud rtsi babs/ /nad de bde ba chen por gyur/ /sems nyid don dang gnyis med bsre/ /de yang tshad pa'i nad byung na/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sbyor mtshams nas/ /bdud rtsi dkar bsil rgyun babs pas/ /lus khengs tshad nad zhi bar bsgom/ /rlung ni nang du mi gzung bar/ /phyir 'phangs phyir gzung rab tu bsngags/ /grang ba'i nad la lte ba nas/ /padma mkha' 'gro'i sbyor mtshams nas/ /bdud rtsi dmar gsal me 'bar bas/ /pho ba'i nang nas lus kun khengs/ /tshig cing rdos bcas dag par bsam/ /rlung ni nang bzung kha sbyar la/ /yi ge yid kyis bzla bar bya/ /bad kan la ni mgrin pa nas/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro'i sbyor mtshams nas/ /bdud rtsi babs pas bad kan byang*/ /rlung ni phyir 'don gtum mo bsgom/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro'i yi ge bzlas/ /'khrul 'khor bya zhing yan lag spyod/ /'dus pa'i nad la snying ga yi/ /rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i sbyor mtshams nas/ /dwangs ma babs pas lus khengs pas/ /steng 'og rlung ni kha sbyor bsgom/ /de dag kun gyi grogs nyid du/ /gsang ba bde skyong 'khor lo nas/ /las gyi mkha' 'gro'i rlung byung bas/ /nad gdon gtor bsregs sbyangs par bsgom/ khyad par rlung gi nad byung na/ /gsang bar mkha' 'gro nyi shu brgyad/ /sbyor mtshams rlung gi dwangs ma yis/

/lus khengs bde skyong bde ba rgyas/ /mi rtog stong pa'i ngang la gzhag /'jam rlung gsang bar gzung bar bya/ /de ltar lus gnad 'byung 'khrugs na/ /rlung dmigs yi ges 'don par bya/ /sems gnad snying rlung rnam rtog 'phro/ /dgag sgrub nyon mongs skyes pa'i tshe/ /gang shar ngo bo ngos bzung la/ rang sor bzhag pas rang gis grol/ /gdod nas ma skyes gzhi rtsa bral/ /ye stong ka dag chos kyi sku/ /rgya mtsho las ni rlabs bzhin du/ /sems nyid don dam rgya mtsho las/ /ye shes rba rlabs rang shar bas/ /shar tsam nyid nas gzhi la thim/ /gtad med stong pa'i lam khyer bya/ /gang ltar na yang rang gi sems/ /sems ni stong pa ngos gzung med/ /na sa na mkhan gnyis su med/ /na rgyu chos dbyings stong par grol/ /nam mkhan sems nyid ngang du thim/ /na sa rdul phran tsam du med/ /de ltar bltas te lam khyer bya/ /spyir na ma rig nyon mongs las/ /'byung bzhi 'khrugs te nad du gyur/ /don la gnyis med chu zla tsam/ /ngo bo ngos gzung gnyis su med/ /thams cad ro mnyam chos sku'i ngang*/ /snang ba sna tshogs gzigs mor che/ /de ltar mthong ba'i rnal 'byor la/ /sdug bsngal chos nyid stong par grol/ /rkyen rnams bde chen grogs su 'char/ /me la bud shing bsnan pa bzhin/ /gang 'dug 'og min mkha' spyod yin/ /gang shar chos sku'i rol pa yin/ /gang snang rang grol gnyug ma yin/ /rang gzhan dge ba'i phun tshogs chu gter las/ /stong pa'i 'dab stong snying rje'i snying po can/ /gzhan phan dri bsung phyogs bcur ldang ba yis/ /ma lus 'gro ba'i don kun sgrub byed yin/ /chos tshul 'di ni theg mchog rin chen mdzod/ /thar par 'gro ba dag gi them skas te/ /gnyis med ye shes gdod ma'i khang bzangs su/ /kun dga'i dus ston rgya cher 'phel byed yin/ /bdag blo'i mkha' la rtogs pa'i chu 'dzin 'khrigs/ /don zab 'brug sgra snying rje'i glog phreng can/

/phan bde'i char rgyun rab tu 'bab pa yis/ /dad ldan skye bo'i pad mtsho gang bar shog /bdag gis legs smon sngon sbyangs ge sar las/ /gzhan phan snying rje'i 'dab ma dkyus ring bas/ /yid mkha'i chu gter rab tu brgyan pa de/ dad ldan skye bo'i bya tshogs brten par shog /chos tshul rgya mtsho'i rgya mtsho ji srid bar/ /bde chen mchog nas mchog tu 'gro ba kun/ /thar pa gang nas gang du rab 'gro bas/ /yon tan phun tshogs phun tshogs gnyis 'grub ste/ /spangs rtogs mthar phyin mthar phyin sangs rgyas shog /bdud rtsi'i sprin phung zhes bya ba/ dpal o rgyan gyi mkhas pa chen po mtsho skyes rdo rjes rjes su bzung ba'i rnal 'byor pa dri med 'od zer gyis gangs ri thod dkar du ston rnams kyi tshe/ rin chen shog 'dra'i ngos la bkod pa rdzogs so/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen bka' 'bum/ (8)bdud rtsi sprin phung*/ -PAGE 244--PAGE 245--PAGE 232-
